title: Quantum algorithms for Young measures: applications to nonlinear partial differential equations
summary: Many nonlinear PDEs have singular or oscillatory solutions or may exhibit physical instabilities or uncertainties. This requires a suitable concept of physically relevant generalized solutions. Dissipative measure-valued solutions have been an effective analytical tool to characterize PDE behavior in such singular regimes. They have also been used to characterize limits of standard numerical schemes on classical computers.
